principles: Reply from the merchant's perspective in natural conversation.
Future follow-up wording may be used without a pre-existing task or started-work record.
Specific business facts and already-started or completed progress remain grounded in actual information.
Polish preserves existing intent and commitments; translation preserves tense and certainty.
Preserve current output, requirement, image provenance and send-ledger contracts.

implementation.existing_adoption_ui: 资料与政策 → 内置内容 → 编辑新版并更新

upgrade_recovery.scope: obsolete account-owned WhatsApp automatic batches only
preconditions: AccountRepository holds the workspace process lock.
Only a prepared operation with explicit submission_started=false, no message ID or ACK, and a matching frozen part/identity is cancelled.
Accepted batches, submitted/unknown operations and any conflicting part ID, ACK or submission evidence remain unchanged; all batches for the same source are checked.

Regeneration eligibility requires a wholly unsent source across all its batches, next_index=0, a completed original attempt with a known positive count below 3, matching original owner and source fingerprint.
The original attempt ID, count, source key, operation and batch records are retained; an exhausted budget is not restored.
Recovery does not restore reception authorization or execute a send.
upgrade_recovery.implementation_review_finding: Old-owner prepared batches missing prompt_version could remain blocked while their generation attempt stayed completed.

prior_check_failures: The first request-assembly run inspected knowledge inside the context object rather than at the wire-envelope top level; two subtests errored after the application had already returned the future reply. The assertion was corrected and all 11 tests passed. No production rejection was established by that failure.

An ad hoc log wrapper encountered a Windows GBK console-encoding error while printing Node test status. The generator tests were rerun with ASCII-safe status output and passed; the application code was unaffected.

resolved: retire only proven-unsent obsolete batches despite old owner process IDs
preserve exhausted or missing attempt budgets and their original completed state
veto regeneration on part ACKs and any same-source batch submission evidence
compare historical batch records before and after recovery
post_review_followups: Exhausted original attempts remain completed; no counter or eligibility is restored.
Historical batch equality is checked against a read-only database snapshot taken before recovery initialization.
